Not to one up or anything in your thread, but a fun bit of trivia... Wilson Pickett - Hey Jude (w/ Duane Allman)

Only time as far as I'm aware, that a cover version of a song shared the charts with the original. Wilson was down in Muscle Shoals, GA, recording his new album. Duane was a monster session player there, and on this session in particular. However, he couldn't read charts.

After they got done recording the rest of the album, they were taking a break and still had some time to burn and Duane, who knew the arrangement and parts, suggested it. They went with it, and the rest is history.
